svg.title: Lissajous Latch — 5:4 frequency ratio neon knot
svg.desc: A zero-dependency SVG generated in pure Python showing a closed 5:4 Lissajous curve with cyan-magenta neon glow, oscilloscope grid, and parameter annotations.

g.text: Two perpendicular sine waves lock into a closed neon knot when the frequency ratio is rational.
